purpose: HMRC Annual Stamp Tax Statistics 2024 to 2025 (corrected 11 March 2026), the 2024-25 rows the property purchases stage fits households' additional-dwelling and non-residential purchases to (uk-data#573, microcosm#1095): Table 6b transactions paying the higher rates on additional dwellings, every buyer, by price band (the HRAD transactions, value and receipts); Table 8a residential transactions, value and receipts for individuals and for other buyers (the individuals' shares that allocate HRAD to households); and Table 8b non-residential transactions, value and receipts for individuals, by price band. Every fact covers England and Northern Ireland and transactions of GBP 40,000 or above. No value is derived here.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
